Name: Fire Emblem Style Portraits for East Scarp
Author: AvianRPG
Description:
[b][color=#f1c232][size=4]Description[/size][/color][/b]
This is a collection of Fire Emblem style portraits created for the cast of the wonderful East Scarp!

For configuration instructions please skip to the end!
(Also big thank you to TheFrenchDodo for explaining to me how to set the code to auto confirm if a mod was installed, so that I didn't have to make my giant configuration menu)

[b][color=#f1c232][size=4]A Note[/size][/color][/b]
Please know that right now it is mostly just the original mod cast and their lovable animal companions, however I do have plans to expand the portraits to the other East Scarp mods (provided their creators give me permission). This is going to be a one step at a time sort of project so please be patient ^_^

If you find any bugs (and there may be some as I'm not far enough in my test playthrough to have seen every special portrait) please, please, please let me know! :) For the Custom Companions since these have a very different setup, please see the Read Me file either here or in the Custom Companion folder in the mod

I'm going to try to keep a tracking chart below so you know which characters are currently available.

[b][color=#f1c232][size=4]Configuration Instructions![/size][/color][/b]
You have the option to have just the animal portraits or just the NPC portraits if you want them. Set your Config values as follows

[b]Variable Name[/b] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿| [b]﻿ ﻿Description[/b] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿       ﻿     | ﻿[b]Default Value[/b]
EastScarpMainAnimals  ﻿| ﻿enables/disables Fire Emblem inspired portraits for the original animal companions of East Scarp   ﻿| ﻿True
EastScarpMainNPCs ﻿      | ﻿enables/disables Fire Emblem inspired portraits for the original NPCs of East Scarp ﻿ ﻿ ﻿   ﻿| ﻿True
